sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t),
com AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND status IN ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled') AND created_at>=e.t),
snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl, captured_at FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC)
SELECT 'A_filled_tickers' k, count(*)::text v FROM fl
UNION ALL SELECT 'B_settled_flat', count(*)::text FROM snap WHERE qty=0 AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'C_still_open', count(*)::text FROM snap WHERE qty IS NULL OR abs(qty)>0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'D_open_AND_committed', count(*)::text FROM snap s JOIN com USING (market_ticker) WHERE s.qty IS NULL OR abs(s.qty)>0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'E_open_NOT_committed', rpad(s.market_ticker,44)||' qty='||COALESCE(s.qty::text,'?')||' statuses='||COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT o.status,',') FROM live_orders o, e WHERE o.market_ticker=s.market_ticker AND o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.created_at>=e.t),'-') FROM snap s WHERE (s.qty IS NULL OR abs(s.qty)>0.01) AND s.market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM com)
UNION ALL SELECT 'F_flat_no_realized', rpad(market_ticker,44)||' qty='||COALESCE(qty::text,'?') FROM snap WHERE qty=0 AND realized_pnl IS NULL
ORDER BY 1
